items.name: Homepage search
items.desc: Full-screen random background photo with a search box in the middle. Type-ahead suggests garments (by title) and vocabulary values.

items.name: Category menu
items.desc: Nested category menu: a dropdown on desktop and a full-screen sidebar on mobile.

items.name: Category pages
items.desc: /category/... lists every garment in a category and its subcategories, with a breadcrumb.

items.name: Filter menu
items.desc: Filter the category pages by type, gender, model, material, color, procedure and process. Filters live in the URL.

items.name: Garment page
items.desc: Image carousel, title, two-line article code, category breadcrumb, and every attribute linking to a filtered browse.

items.name: Similar garments
items.desc: Up to 10 similar garments on each garment page, scored by shared attributes.

items.name: Source on garment page
items.desc: Shows where a garment came from: the uploader's own piece, or an external listing with a link.

items.name: Tree filters with counts
items.desc: Category, color and material filters as trees: tick 'black' to include 010, 010B, etc., with a count next to every option.

items.name: Model pages
items.desc: /model/2600: the model's name, suggested category, and every garment of that model. Model numbers link here everywhere.

items.name: Model variant matrix
items.desc: On a model page, a grid of material × color showing which combinations are known to exist, each cell linking to its garments.

items.name: Color and material pages
items.desc: /color/black.010 or /material/leather.kangaroo: everything in that color or material and below, plus a short description.

items.name: Codebook / glossary
items.desc: Reference pages explaining CCP codes: types, procedures, processes, every material with its composition, every color. Linked from article codes.

items.name: Article code decoder
items.desc: Paste a code like 'LM/2699-IN BIMS-PTC/19' and get it explained piece by piece, with links to matching garments.

items.name: Group listings of the same garment
items.desc: Garments with the same identity (gender + model + material + color) from different retailers shown as one item, with 'seen at 3 retailers'.

items.name: Sorting
items.desc: Sort any grid by newest, model number or title.

items.name: Grid / list view
items.desc: Switch between an image grid and a dense list with codes in columns.

items.name: Image zoom / lightbox
items.desc: Full-screen image viewer with zoom on the garment page.

items.name: Recently added
items.desc: A feed of the newest garments, on the homepage or its own page.

items.name: Random garment
items.desc: A button that opens a random garment, for browsing the archive.

items.name: Color swatches
items.desc: A small swatch next to every color, from a hex value stored on each color.

items.name: Sign in / sign up
items.desc: Clerk-hosted sign-in, avatar in the header.

items.name: User profiles
items.desc: /user/name: avatar, username and the garments that user uploaded.

items.name: Upload a garment
items.desc: Form with image upload (JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP up to 10 MB, converted to WebP) and every field. Source is 'my own garment' or an external link. Lands as pending.

items.name: Edit your own garments
items.desc: Owners can edit their garment from its page.

items.name: User sync
items.desc: Clerk webhook keeps the users collection in step (created, updated, deleted).

items.name: Favorites / wishlist
items.desc: Save garments to a list on your profile.

items.name: 'I own this'
items.desc: Mark garments you own; your profile shows your collection. Optional public/private.

items.name: Suggest a correction
items.desc: Anyone signed in can propose a fix to a garment's fields; it lands in the admin queue instead of changing the garment directly.

items.name: Add photos to an existing garment
items.desc: Contribute extra photos of a garment already in the archive, reviewed like new submissions.

items.name: Review queue
items.desc: Every pending garment from users and the pipeline: publish, reject or edit. Image lightbox. Filter by source and by why it was held back, ranked by how many garments share each blocker.

items.name: Add missing values inline
items.desc: Unknown values are flagged in review, and can be added to the vocabulary without leaving the queue.

items.name: Ingest review details
items.desc: For pipeline garments: why they were held back, each field's confidence and where it came from, the LLM's notes.

items.name: Re-check queue
items.desc: Re-tests pending garments against the current vocabulary and publishes anything no longer blocked.

items.name: Ingest runs
items.desc: Run history with per-source counters and errors, and unpublish-by-run.

items.name: Vocabulary manager
items.desc: Add, edit and delete vocabulary values (flat list today).

items.name: Homepage backgrounds
items.desc: Rotating homepage images. Stored in the database, but there is no admin screen for them today.

items.name: Tree vocabulary editor
items.desc: One editor for every collection: models, colors, materials, extras, categories and the flat lists. Add, rename and move nodes.

items.name: Bulk edit
items.desc: Select many garments and set a field on all of them at once (e.g. add an extra, change a color).

items.name: Data quality dashboard
items.desc: Lists of garments with problems: no material/color, single-layer values, category different from the model, models with no garments.

items.name: Edit history
items.desc: Every change to a garment recorded: who changed which field, from what to what, and when. Shown on the garment for admins.

items.name: Merge duplicates
items.desc: Combine two garments that are really the same listing, keeping all images.

items.name: Backgrounds screen
items.desc: Upload, remove and toggle homepage backgrounds from the admin.

items.name: Vercel analytics
items.desc: Page analytics and speed insights.

items.name: Link previews and SEO
items.desc: Proper page titles, Open Graph images (the garment's cover photo) for shared links, and a sitemap.

items.name: Dark mode
items.desc: Follows the system setting.

items.name: About page
items.desc: What Wikipoell is, how to contribute, credits.
